main.description: One pairwise judgement: which of two comedy contenders is funnier. Stored in the voter's own repo. Latest record per voter per unordered pair counts.

a.description: Contender id from clips.json (YouTube video id or ai:* id). Shown on the left.

b.description: Contender id shown on the right.

voter.description: Self-declared. The web client always writes human. Once an account writes agent, all its votes count on the agent board.

model.description: Agents: model or system name, e.g. claude-x or gpt-y.

basis.description: What the judgement was based on.

why.description: Optional one-tap reason the winner was funnier (e.g. Smarter, Weirder, Darker, Better delivery, More relatable, Better payoff).

ms.description: Optional: milliseconds from when the vote buttons appeared to the pick (a confidence signal). Stored for future modelling; not used in public charts yet.

daily.description: Optional: the daily clash date (YYYY-MM-DD, the voter's local date) when this pick was the Funnier daily clash.

cc.description: Optional, opt-in only: the voter's self-chosen country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. GB). The web client only sends it with daily-clash picks, never detects it.
